question: of the citations the register counted, what share point at a source unit that actually carries the intent?

denominator.unit_of_measure: origin links (one unit can carry several links)
denominator.warning: 2,252 origin links and 1,938 distinct cited units are different quantities; a precision measured over links must not be multiplied into a unit count

retrieval_failure_modes.why: reports "fuixed" as done, not a request
agent status block "Cloud/web state", not operator ask
"You sourced hte image before dl" past report
"still demands codex sub" complaint, no directive
rambles on credentials/containerization, no Tracera/AgilePlus deployment
"For letters All + D parallel eyes" too garbled
"old cached crawls" diagnosed, no re-read order
"Pdf lacks TREE" complaint, no fix directive
"overalls etup tstate?" garbled, plus Discord ask

caveats.single_labeller: one model labeller produced all 60 verdicts; no second pass exists
caveats.n_60: n=60 links sampled from 2252; a Wilson interval is reported but the sample is not stratified by channel
caveats.quote_fidelity_is_not_precision: ask_link_verification.json measures whether the quoted words appear in the cited utterance (strict 97.08%, folded 99.13%). That is a precondition, not a measure of whether the utterance belongs to the intent, which is what this file measures
caveats.partial_is_not_free: the lenient figure credits a unit that states only part of the claim or fits a sibling ask equally well; quote both, never the lenient one alone
